packages.name: Sphinx discounts pay for the top end

keep.Disenchant: the cheapest answer to an artifact or enchantment
keep.Cloud's Limit Break: 2 mana kills a tapped attacker; Omnislash during an opponent's combat destroys all their tapped attackers while our Sphinxes stand untapped
keep.Stroke of Midnight: instant answer to any nonland permanent; holds the slot until a second Void Rend arrives (buylist)
keep.Time Wipe: the reset that keeps the engine: return Unesh (or the commander) to hand first, then recast it
keep.Tragic Arrogance: we choose what every player keeps: our best Sphinx stays, their best threats go, and sacrifice beats indestructible
keep.Mind Stone: ramp toward a 9-mana commander; cycles away when the mana is no longer needed
keep.Spectacular Tactics: two-mode 2-mana instant: protects Unesh or the commander (hexproof / indestructible / a blink), or kills a big threat
keep.Stone by Sunlight: two-mode 2-mana instant: protects Unesh or the commander (hexproof / indestructible / a blink), or kills a big threat
keep.Getaway Glamer: two-mode 2-mana instant: protects Unesh or the commander (hexproof / indestructible / a blink), or kills a big threat
keep.Essence Scatter: cheap counters: the field's An Offer, Arcane Denial, Swan Song and Mana Drain are all committed to other decks
keep.Power Sink: cheap counters: the field's An Offer, Arcane Denial, Swan Song and Mana Drain are all committed to other decks
